notes: Markup tools, much faster PDF loading, and fixes to AI Find duplicates and layer merging.

features: Markups: pen, line, arrow, polyline, shapes, revision cloud, highlight, text, callout and pinned notes, in a panel of their own. Ctrl+Z undoes markups and layer edits alike.
Export markups either flattened into the sheet or as editable PDF annotations that open in Bluebeam with their author and date.
fixes: Large PDF sets open in seconds instead of minutes. The remaining sheets draw in the background, nearest to what you are looking at first.
AI Find no longer stacks several boxes on the same symbol.
Merging two layers redraws the incoming marks at the destination layer mark size, so the merged layer looks like one layer.
Selection panel buttons no longer paint outside their box.
